name: antigem-plugins
description: Official Antigem plugins repository: 2D Video Editing Studio (v3.4.0), Facebook Automation & SEO Studio (v1.7.0), Meta Suite Page Management (v2.3.0), and DeepX Google Flow Studio (v1.0.0).

plugins.name: 2d-video-editing-studio
plugins.description: Senior Video Editor & Autonomous 2D Production Engine (v3.4.0): 6 Official Fully-Specified Styles (Vox/Box Paper, Stickman, Sticker, Noir, Hand-Drawn Doodle, Retro Arcade) with Recipe-Driven Autopilot Edits, Voice-Synced Asset Placement (no dummy/stale assets), Google Flow Agent Mode & Batch Dispatch, Anti-Offline Server Shield, 52-89 FPS High-Speed Render Presets, Instant Help CLI, 15-Minute Timeline Scaling Laws, Broadcast Vox explainers, Bento Box data cards, Stickman storytelling, and Multi-Domain Google Flow Bridge.

plugins.name: facebook-automation
plugins.description: Pre-Trained Phone (Desktop-on-Phone www.facebook.com & Mobile Touch m.facebook.com) and Desktop Facebook Automation Engine (v1.7.0): Dedicated Feed Posts (Text/Photo/Carousel/Video), Anti-Comment Firewall (strictly never posts into comments), Reels (/reels/create + automatic mobile fallback + video event dispatch), Stories (/stories/create Photo/Video with overlay story_text & Text Story), Real Video/Reel Thumbnail & Cover Uploader, Multiline Formatted Caption Engine (Title + Description + Bullets + CTA + 3-6 #Hashtags), and Zero-Overthinking 1-Call Dispatch.

plugins.name: meta-suite-automation
plugins.description: Master Autonomous Meta Suite Production Engine (v2.3.0): Enterprise Meta Business Suite Facebook Page management, auto-open Meta Business Suite on login, persistent bridge background thread, embedded multi-platform trend radar, 1-click publishing & scheduling of Page Reels, Long Videos, Photos, Stories with in-memory DataTransfer injection, synthetic clipboard paste, anti-ad organic shield, and Google Flow AI media generation.

plugins.name: deepx-google-flow
plugins.description: DeepX Google Flow Studio (v1.0.0): the full DeepX Google Flow extension as an AntiGem MCP plugin (no side panel). Asks Agent Mode vs Standard mode before every generation, Agent Mode auto-splits >24 prompts into ≤24-item parts pasted back-to-back with 100% autopilot approvals, Standard mode auto-switches to Agent Mode on Google 'unusual activity / extension' blocks. Nano Banana 2.1/Pro, Omni Flash 1.2, Veo 3.1, storyboard analyzer, characters, references, scene chaining, upscale and all deepx_*/flow_* tools.
